name: TextField
summary: A labeled native input with linked hints and validation messages.
usage: Use for a single native input with a persistent label. The caller owns value, validation and submission. Keep domain-specific validation and credentials in the feature; use other native controls for multiline text or selection.
accessibility: Associates label and input through a stable id; links hint and error descriptions and sets aria-invalid for errors. Native required, disabled, ref and keyboard behavior are preserved. The feature owns dynamic error summaries or announcements.

props.name: type
props.meaning: Supports text, email, password, search, tel, url, number and native date/time inputs. Use separate native controls for checkbox, radio, file, range or other selection behavior.

props.name: label
props.meaning: Persistent accessible label; a placeholder cannot replace it.

props.name: id
props.meaning: Optional DOM id; a stable useId value is generated when absent.

props.name: hint
props.meaning: Optional help linked to the input through aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.meaning: Caller-owned validation message linked to the input; also marks it invalid.

props.name: …inputProps
props.meaning: Native value/defaultValue, onChange, type, required, disabled, className, ref and ARIA props are forwarded. Existing aria-describedby references are retained.

examples.label: Labeled input and validation
examples.description: Synthetic form input with a hint, validation message and disabled state.
examples.code:
<TextField label="Name" hint="Shown to your colleagues." required />
<TextField label="Email" type="email" error="Enter an email address." />
